subject: proj-dy
title: (R)PROJ.DY.------IF.SPT.
description: Chart on book p. 129 (T(AF)M-33). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; IF-SPT (infra-spirituality) is the partner. From the subject: AFI (affinity insight), IF-SPT-2 (infra-spirituality, a second IF-SPT label) and TR (transformation). From AFI: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From IF-SPT-2: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and MTH (methodology). From PHY-U-P: POL-P (political policies). From MTH: HI-P (high purpose).
